newsitem.title: UK: ENEL will not tender to buy fuel this year - official.
newsitem.headline: ENEL will not tender to buy fuel this year - official.

text.p: Enel, the Italian state power company, will not tender to buy any heavy fuel oil this year and is "highly unlikely" to buy through tenders in the first quarter 1997, an Enel official said on Tuesday.
Tenders to buy low sulphur fuel have been a regular feature of the European fuel market in recent years but the company has changed its purchasing policy over the last couple of years.
In the lead up to privatisation next year Enel has moved away from tendering, preferring to buy through term contracts and spot purchases.
"It would be against our principles to revert to tendering now. It would be a step backwards," said a source at the company.
